Plasmablastic lymphoma is a distinct subtype of B-cell lymphoma, characterized by plasmablastic differentiation (CD138+). While it can be aggressive, it is not the same as 'Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma' (DLBCL), which is another specific subtype. The immunophenotype (CD138+, CD20-) and genetic findings (BCL6, MYC, IGH rearrangements) are more consistent with Plasmablastic lymphoma than typical DLBCL.
